scope.description: A context-specific marine painting direction that organizes the view through a luminous reflection path, directional wave marks, and atmospheric separation between foreground water and distant sea or sky. It controls how light and water are painted; it does not prescribe a ship, storm, time of day, or narrative.
limitations: Apply only when the user requests a sea or ocean scene; do not add water to other subjects.
Preserve user-specified weather, time, light source, horizon, vessel count, and aspect ratio.
Add no ship, person, shoreline, moon, sun, storm, or narrative event unless requested.
Do not reproduce a named painting, its exact horizon, wave silhouette, figures, or vessel arrangement.

rules.applies_when: The requested marine scene includes a visible light source or bright opening in the sky.
rules.instruction: Carry the source light onto the water as a broken, narrowing or widening path of reflections that responds to the wave planes; retain dark blue-gray intervals between highlights.
rules.observable: The reflection connects sky and water visually, follows the surface, and remains composed of distinct light marks rather than a uniform glow stripe.
rules.reject_when: Light floats above the surface, forms a straight graphic beam, or erases the dark-water structure.
rules.avoid: bloom halo, uniform glitter, mirror-flat stripe, and unrelated secondary light sources

rules.applies_when: The user requests visible open water, waves, or reflections.
rules.instruction: Align short curved or tapering marks with the observed wave movement; vary mark length, spacing, and contrast from foreground to distance, reserving crisp light accents for selected crests.
rules.observable: Marks describe water motion and recede in scale and contrast without turning into repeated decorative stripes.
rules.reject_when: Water reads as a repeated pattern, a flat blue field, or an unrelated thick-impasto texture.
rules.avoid: evenly spaced parallel lines, noisy white foam everywhere, and texture detached from wave direction

rules.applies_when: The requested composition includes a visible horizon or distant water.
rules.instruction: Keep the user-requested horizon and establish distance with restrained shifts in edge softness, value, and color; reserve the strongest local contrast for the requested focal area.
rules.observable: Foreground, horizon, and sky remain distinct but share coherent air and light.
rules.reject_when: A hard cutout horizon, uniform contrast, or generic blue overlay flattens the depth.
rules.avoid: arbitrary horizon relocation, heavy vignette, and global blue filter

joint_checks.instruction: Let reflected light, wave direction, and atmospheric depth work as one coherent treatment while preserving the user's requested scene and object inventory.
joint_checks.observable: Water motion is readable; the reflection belongs to the water surface; distance is visible; no unrequested narrative object has appeared.
